source: direct user response to the upper image projection / camera-facing projection / defer-scalar choice
interpretation: Adopt the recommended upper image projection of the independently identified physical target at the existing fixed centre column, for the offline challenger.

proposal_record.heading: Same-surface projected branches — scalar convention pending

rule.location: Keep x=floor(existing GlassGeometry.ellipse.center_x+0.5), with explicit source/ROI conversion. Public crop centres remain diagnostic geometry.
rule.target: Establish physical surface/role independently. Among its projected branches, read its upper outline at that column from current observed support.
rule.single_projection: A clearly identified single upper projection is allowed; seeing two arcs is not a mandatory gate.
rule.unavailable: A missing, occluded, ambiguous or unsupported required upper projection leaves this role without numeric Y. Do not substitute a visible lower projection.
rule.prohibited: No highest-raw-edge rule, object/branch identity from Y alone, branch average, filled interval, interpolation, carried coordinate, moved X or side median.
rule.independence: Apply to each independently identified role; Oil/Foam identity and availability stay separate.
rule.conversion: Reuse GlassGeometry.level_px_from_zero and level_mm_from_zero only after an eligible observed Y exists.
rule.meaning: Consistent image-height convention, not a reconstruction of three-dimensional liquid-plane height.
rule.precision: This policy does not certify any agent marker, contour pixel, numeric tolerance or scalar accuracy.
rule.integration: Offline design/reference qualification first; production and W3 original-candidate-Y semantics remain unchanged until a qualified candidate is integrated.
